ingredientSections.heading: Meats
items: 150g Italian D.O.P Spec Prosciutto
150g Two Rivers Coppa, aged in-house at Puccini's
150g D-Original Fuet Salami, a local artisan salami maker
150g Two Rivers Beef Bresoala, Two Rivers is another great North Shore business
150g Two Rivers Spicequale, Puccini's own recipe and aged in house

ingredientSections.heading: Cheese
items: 150g Parmigiano Reggiano Vacche Rosse, the oldest reggiano in B.C. only 8 wheels get imported each year and Puccini's gets two wheels a year
150g Louie D'Or, a rich, strong, Quebec cheese
150g wedge D'affinois Brie, a creamy double cream French brie
100g Robiola Goat Cheese, a fresh Italian goat cheese, imported by Puccini's every 2 weeks from Italy
150g Montesardo Sheep Cheese, a sharp hard cheese imported from Italy
125g Italian Organic Gorgonzola, D.O.P Italian cheese, by a world renowned Gorgonzola Maker

ingredientSections.heading: Antipasto
items: 150g Mixed Mediterranean Olives, a mixture of 7 different types of olives with a bit of spice
125g Gherkins from France (marinated in vinegar, great for meats and cheese)
12 pieces Spicy Asparagus, ideal for dry salami and sharp cheeses
6 pieces Grilled Eggplant wrapped around Provolone and Sundried Tomatoes
Crackers and Breadsticks
Fine Cheese Co. Olive Oil and Sea Salt Crackers
Italian Crostini Rosemary Crackers
Italian Olive Oil Breadsticks

ingredientSections.heading: Jelly
items: Red Pepper Jelly, locally made
Port Wine Jelly, locally made

methodSections.heading: Charcuterie Board
steps: Arrange all meats, cheeses, antipasto items, crackers, breadsticks and jellies on a large board or platter for serving.
